answer: Farming becomes an umber bet on surviving 94 epochs of grading, and every gale settlement recomputes the beacon schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 94 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
